verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe the pieces of a full payroll cycle — retrieving upcoming/unprocessed payrolls (review), pre-built UI Flows and API endpoints for processing and submitting regular and off-cycle payrolls, and tax/withholding handling — plus community sentiment confirming payroll runs 'just work' end-to-end for admins. However the evidence is fragmented across API guides (complete-a-regular-payroll, off-cycle, platform-overview) rather than showing one consolidated review→preview-totals→submit UI flow, and no dedicated 'preview totals' endpoint for regular (non-contractor) payroll is cited. Missing for 10: a single documented UI/API flow that explicitly chains hours review, dollar-total preview, and submission in one pass, and first-hand ops-user account of doing this in one sitting.
